semantics: DY[i*INCY] := DA*DX[i*INCX] + DY[i*INCY] for i in [0,N)

shape_rules.increments: INCX >= 1 and INCY >= 1 (see F_DOT_F64_V1 for the negative-increment policy)

preconditions: DX is an f64 rank-1 input with positive stride.
DY is an f64 rank-1 writable view with positive stride and the same length as DX.
postconditions: On OK, DY holds DA*DX + DY evaluated in that association.

aliasing.note: DX and DY may alias exactly (in-place axpy on a single buffer). Partial overlap is not documented by DAXPY and is not supported: MAGR requires MAGR_ARRAY_F_MAY_ALIAS plus serialisation by the scheduler.

numerical_contract.accumulation_order: elementwise; DA*DX[i] is formed then added to DY[i]
numerical_contract.reproducibility_note: The compiler may contract a*x+y into an FMA inside daxpy.f. Builds requiring bit-identity must pass -ffp-contract=off to the Fortran compiler; see docs/abi.md.
